items.statement: The report verifies the supplied G1 monomer and dimer as the stated atom-count, charge and singlet systems and preserves their identities during analysis.
items.expected: 64-atom G1 monomer (+2, singlet) and 128-atom two-G1 dimer (+4, singlet) are explicitly checked.

items.statement: Both relaxed structures are validated as minima or the report gives a scientifically justified stability alternative and diagnostics.
items.expected: No imaginary frequencies are reported for the optimized structures, consistent with energetic minima.

items.statement: The monomer geometry has the reported twisted dihedral pattern.
items.expected: Benzyl-pyridinium dihedrals near 50.67° and 50.65°, and pyridinium-naphthalene dihedrals near 30.28° and 30.27°.

items.statement: The dimer geometry has the reported offset parallel packing descriptors.
items.expected: Interplanar naphthalene stacking separation near 3.63 Å and slip angle near 44.89°; report the full centroid-vector length separately and define the plane convention.
